values.note: Site with no services $19 a night, adding electricity $7, water $6 and sewer $8; full hookup $40. The $5 reservation fee applies to advance bookings only (drop-ins don't pay it). 2026 season Apr 9 - Oct 12.

note: City of Galesburg campground at Lake Storey Recreation Area. Drop-ins welcome. Stays over two weeks only on four 30-day sites. Campers get free wristbands (four per site) for the Lakeside Water Park about 600 ft away in its summer season. RV Life lists it as commercial; it is municipal. --Claude
